pressure_note: No pressure column is printed. Text: 25-75 C in Lipkin pycnometers; 75-175 C in sealed glass dilatometer tubes 'under the combined pressure of the air trapped in the dilatometer and the water that evaporated from the solution' (air partial pressure about 3 atm at 175 C); i.e. the solution's own saturation pressure plus trapped air, not controlled.
title_as_printed: Comparison of Measured and Calculated Densities of NaCl Solutions [the printed table also holds Na2SO4 and MgSO4 blocks]

footnotes_as_printed.a: (7)  [attached to ICT in Table I = International Critical Tables, ref. 7]

value2.what: International Critical Tables value interpolated to the same T and m (blank where not given)

value3.what: density calculated by the authors from their apparent-molal-volume correlation (eq 3-5)

composition.other_species: pure water as solvent (distilled water implied; purity not stated); single salt per block, set from the label row

extra_unmapped: Calcd. density (authors' correlation) mapped as value3
conversion_needs: density in g/cc (printed as 'Grams per cc.'), no conversion needed

composition molality: mol of salt per 1000 g water as printed ('molality'); the paper defines apparent molal volume with 'V is the volume of a solution containing 1000 grams of water and m moles of solute'
notes: Printed side-by-side blocks (NaCl 25-175 C; Na2SO4 25-75 C at left and 100-175 C at right; MgSO4 25-175 C) were restacked: one label row per salt and molality, then 8 temperature rows (25,45,65,75,100,125,150,175 C). Na2SO4 temperature rows from the two printed halves were merged by script. Printed '...' (or blank) ICT cells (T >= 125 C for NaCl, Na2SO4 and MgSO4; MgSO4 100 C) written as empty. MgSO4 molalities 0.00972..0.29165 as printed. One ICT cell (MgSO4 0.00972 m, 65 C) is smudged in the text layer ('0.98*18') and was read as 0.9818 from the image.
